Who We Are

Connecting global capacity with local expertise

SKY RE is a Reinsurance Agent that acts on behalf of Reinsurers to underwrite complex commercial P&C risks — including Property, Engineering, Casualty, Energy and Marine — distributing risks locally through enhanced underwriting expertise, and bringing international capacity through a superior network.

02Core Brand Values

Four values that guide every decision

01

Underwriting Discipline

“Securing trust through meticulous risk management.”

As an MGA, we are the trusted custodians of global capital. We honor this responsibility by maintaining the highest standards of technical analysis, strict underwriting integrity, and transparent governance — protecting the balance sheets of our capacity providers while offering consistent, reliable security to our clients.

02

High-Altitude Vision

“Anticipating the future of risk.”

We look beyond conventional boundaries, actively designing sophisticated, forward-thinking solutions for complex and emerging risk landscapes — including cyber liabilities, climate transitions and political risk. We don't just respond to today's market; we prepare our partners for tomorrow's realities.

03

Local Authority, Global Reach

“Deep Riyadh roots, institutional global networks.”

We possess an intimate understanding of the Saudi regulatory environment, regional business dynamics and the unique scale of the Kingdom's transforming economy. By marrying this local expertise with a world-class global network, we translate complex regional risks into structured, secure opportunities.

04

Co-Aligned Partnership

“Aligning capital with long-term resilience.”

We reject transactional relationships. We operate as a strategic extension of our capacity partners and a dedicated ally to local markets — deploying our underwriting capacity to foster mutual growth, drive economic stability and build lasting structural resilience.

05 · Governance

Legal notices and disclosures

Public-facing information about SKY RE, this website and how it handles your information.

01Legal entity+

SKY RE® is the trading name of Sky Universal Company, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. SKY RE® is a registered trademark.

02Business model+

SKY RE operates as a reinsurance Managing General Agency (MGA), underwriting on behalf of reinsurers under delegated authority. SKY RE does not retain risk on its own balance sheet.

03Website notice+

This website is for general information only. It does not quote, bind or accept submissions, and nothing on it constitutes an offer of cover or an underwriting decision.

04Privacy+

This website does not collect or store personal data. Enquiry emails are prepared and sent from the visitor's own email application.

05Cookies and local storage+

This website sets no cookies. Two display preferences — light or dark theme, and sound on or off — are kept in your browser's local storage so they are remembered on your next visit.

06Regulatory information+

Details to follow

Through the Star · The Brand Story
02The Story of the Symbol

Two opposing crescents — and a star born of their joining

Global Reach · Offshoreالامتداد العالمي
Local Authority · Onshoreالسلطة المحلية
SKY REسكاي ري
01 / 06

The Form

The mark is formed by two opposing waxing crescents. When they join, the act of joining itself shapes a star. The star is an emergent form — the natural result of a partnership completed.

Reinsurance perspective · sharing risks & rewards
02 / 06

The Upper Crescent
Global Market Reach (Offshore)

It represents international capacity, global underwriting networks, offshore capital, and the institutional reach that SKY RE brings into the Kingdom.

03 / 06

The Downward Crescent
Local Authority (Onshore) & Protection Canopy

It represents the onshore side of the partnership and carries four essential meanings:

01Regional insight
02Proactive regulatory engagement
03Precision in underwriting
04Protective structure for the local market
04 / 06

The Moment of Joining

The most important event in the mark is not either crescent alone, but the precise moment they join. That moment is the partnership becoming real. Everything that matters — the star, the guidance, the completed structure — is born from the join.

05 / 06

The Emergent Star — SKY RE

At the exact moment the crescents join, the partnership itself gives rise to a new guiding star — SKY RE. Not a separately designed element, but the visible result of a successful union between Global Market Reach and Local Authority & Protection.

06 / 06

The Optical Pathway

The eye travels from the outer crescents inward to the star, then expands again — mirroring the flow of capacity: international reach and local authority meet at the centre, and from that meeting, guidance and underwriting solutions flow outward to the market.

03Core Philosophy
“
SKY RE does not stand outside the partnership. It is the living result of the partnership being completed.

The joining of Global Market Reach with Local Authority and Protection naturally creates SKY RE — the new guiding star that emerges from a partnership of sharing risks and rewards.

SKY RE Symbolism · Final & Locked
04Deeper & Subtle Dimensions

Beyond the first reading — layers that enrich the brand

01

The Act of Joining as the Critical Moment

What matters most is not the individual crescents, but the precise moment they join — the partnership becoming real. Everything is born from the join.

02

Protection Canopy + Elevation

The downward crescent shelters the local market while both forms remain waxing — rising. Protection that never suppresses growth; elevation that stays rooted in local authority and regulatory care.

03

Sharing of Risks and Rewards

The crescents face and complete each other: mutual exposure, mutual benefit. Neither side stands alone — the very definition of true partnership in reinsurance.

04

Emergent Guidance

The star does not impose itself from outside — it appears only when the partnership is complete. Genuine leadership arises from successful joining, not from solitary ambition.

05

Optical Pathway

From the edges inward to the star, then outward again — the operational flow of capacity: reach and authority meet at the centre, and solutions flow out to the market.

06

Pattern of Restraint

No excess decoration, no forced closure into a full circle, no aggressive collision. The discipline of the geometry mirrors the discipline of underwriting and regulatory engagement.

05Logo Philosophy

Moon, star and horizon — within a balanced square

The Moon

The crescent forms reference the phases of the waxing moon — a complete, continuous cycle reflecting the principles of continuity and connection within reinsurance.

The Star

At the centre, a focal element unifying the surrounding forms — trust, stability and distinction; a central point of confidence reflecting the company's role as a trusted partner in risk management.

The Horizon

A balanced, symmetrical composition expressing expanse, individuality and continuity.

The Square

A square-based structure reinforces balance, stability and harmony — bringing movement and solidity together within one distinctive identity.

06Alignment with Brand Foundations

Every curve carries a value
